title: KB Entry Created v2
description: Active normalized KB entry-created contract. KB now produces and Hearth now consumes v2. Runtime migration evidence recorded 2026-08-24: event 01M0RZ2V7GWWHGHCE03Y8YY4RJ appeared exactly once in nbus:kb.entry.created.v2 and exactly once in nbus:all; the v1 and DLQ stream heads were unchanged by that probe. kb.entry.created.v1 remains available only for legacy compatibility. This is a cutover, not semantic dual publishing: producers must not emit equivalent v1 and v2 records for the same entry without deduplication.

entry_id.description: Canonical UUID of the created vault entry; legacy id is not accepted.

category.description: Category slug, normalized by kb (lowercase, hyphenated, <=64 chars — kb/src/bus/kb_entry_created_v2.rs Category::Other). Open set by design: a closed enum here caused every novel category (audit, shader-architecture, ...) to dead-letter and stalled autoingest for weeks (2026-08-30 kb lifecycle audit). Known canonical values: research, design, handoff, plan, reference, log, concept, decision, audit.

source_type.description: Source-type slug, normalized by kb (SourceType::Other in kb_entry_created_v2.rs). Open set for the same reason as category: the closed enum here stalled autoingest on `generated` (2026-08-30). Known canonical values: manual, agent-generated, deer-flow-research, deer-flow-guidance, tengine-session, tengine-planning, test-result, bead-outcome, bus-event, codemap-derived.

confidence.description: Confidence is never an unexplained scalar. Each branch identifies whether the value was measured, inferred, or a producer default.

file.description: Absolute path to the written vault markdown entry.
